title: Dune Watch Grayt 30A Vacations
description_expanded: AboutDune Watch ~ 345 Pine Street ~ Grayton Beach FL 32459 Need a last-minute stay? Please call our office at 844-941-1213 to make last-minute bookings via telephone, as availability within the next 7-nights will not show on calendar. We do not allow online bookings within 7-nights/one week of an arrival date. 20% Discount off Spring Break and Spring Rates! 4-night minimum with flexible arrival/departure days. Valid on new bookings only for stays completed prior to May 22nd. Discount is reflected in online pricing. A beautiful, family friendly post-and-pier home in a prime location next to the Grayton Beach State Park, the newly renovated and expanded Dune Watch offers incredible Gulf and Park views. With ­­­2,460 square feet (1,789 interior), Dune Watch sleeps up to 12 and offers 5 bedrooms, 4.5 baths, parking for 6 cars, and a short beach walk (approx. 15 minutes) to downtown Grayton icons The Red Bar, Chiringo’s and The Zoo Gallery. Dune Watch underwent an expansion and total renovation, completed in May, 2024. There is a bed swing underneath the house to enjoy an al fresco afternoon nap, and the covered front porch offers the ABSOLUTE BEST VIEWS of the sunsets over the Gulf and State Park! Historic Grayton Beach is 30A’s original beach community, founded in the mid-1880’s, that has stayed true to its funky, eclectic vibe. With its designated Blue Wave beach, Grayton Beach has been listed in Dr. Steven Leatherman's (“Dr. Beach”) famed Top 10 Beaches of America FOUR times since 1991 (#1 in 1994, #6 in 2016, #3 in 2019, #1 in 2020), thanks to its pristine coastline and untouched dunes. Dune Watch – and Grayton Beach itself - has so much to offer, you may never want to venture farther out along 30A! Main Level: 5 Bedrooms. 4.5 Baths. Fully Equipped Kitchen. Dining Table seats 8-10. Laundry Closet. Living Room. Covered Porch. #1 Bedroom has 2 built-in bunks (4 XL Twins).Full Bath shared by #1 and #2 bedrooms, walk-in shower.#2 Bedroom has a Queen Bed.#3 En-Suite Bedroom has a King bed, Smart TV, walk-in shower.#4 En-Suite Bedroom has a King bed, Smart TV, tub/shower.#5 En-Suite Bedroom has a King bed, Smart TV, walk-in shower. Powder room Amenities: Business Features Wireless Internet (password secured) Entertainment Features 4 Smart TV’s with YouTube TV (TV's in Living Room, #3, #4 and #5 Bedrooms) Distinctive Features 150 feet to Grayton Beach State Park beach access 15-minute beach walk to downtown Grayton Bed, bath and kitchen linens provided (except beach towels) Beach Gear Credit General Features Parking for 6 vehicles (covered and open) 3 King beds, 1 Queen 2 built-in Bunk beds (4 XL Twins) 4 Full bathrooms, powder room, iron, ironing board, hair dryers, outdoor charcoal grill w/grill utensils, outdoor porches, outdoor dining for 12, porch furniture, outdoor hot/cold shower Linens provided. No Smoking. No Pets Kitchen Features Fully equipped kitchen, drip coffee maker, Keurig, electric stove with glass top, refrigerator with water/ice dispenser, separate ice maker, microwave, dishwasher, toaster, blender, washer, dryer. Area Features Timpoochee Trail (30A bike path) Seaside (7/10th mile) State Parks (Tops’l, Grayton Beach, Deer Lake)
